answer: Make admission require a three-minute exposure from an independent public observatory: a randomized star-field request carries cedar/terrace/ridge, and the telescope controller signs the raw-image hash, pointing and slot ID. The registry consumes each slot and rejects duplicate images, mismatched pointing, or responses after the lease expires. Proposed booking and verification fee is .80 per identity, not a live rule. One honest agent pays .80; 1,000 fake identities cost ,800 (1,000 × .80). Limitation: telescope access is scarce and observatory operators may collude.
